# INCIDENT REPORT: NetSupport RAT Infection (2024-11-26)

## Victim Host

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.11.26.183 |
| MAC Address | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| Windows Hostname | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| Domain | NEMOTODES |
| Logged-in User | oboomwald |

## Malware Attribution

**Malware Family:** NetSupport RAT

**Attribution:** Signature-confirmed. Suricata alerts identified:
- "ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity" (Event#3.4022)
- "ETPRO TROJAN Malicious NetSupport Rat CnC Checkin" (Event#3.4023)
- "ET INFO NetSupport Remote Admin Checkin" (Event#3.4025)

## Indicators of Compromise

### Command and Control Endpoints

| Endpoint | Port | Protocol | Purpose | Evidence |
|----------|------|----------|---------|----------|
| 194.180.191.64 | 443 | HTTPS | Primary C2 | 59 outbound packets POST to /fakeurl.htm every 60 seconds; 73 inbound packets with C2 commands |
| 104.26.1.231 | 80 | HTTP | Geolocation lookup | GET /location/loca.asp (geo.netsupportsoftware.com) |

### Malicious Domains

| Domain | IP | Purpose | Evidence |
|--------|----|---------|----|
| modandcrackedapk.com | 193.42.38.139 | Malware delivery / ZPHP distribution | TLS SNI handshakes; 7600 outbound packets, 357 KB inbound (encrypted payload download); Suricata alert "ET CURRENT_EVENTS ZPHP Domain in TLS SNI" (Event#3.4018) |
| geo.netsupportsoftware.com | 104.26.1.231 | Geolocation metadata | GET request to /location/loca.asp |

### C2 Protocol Indicators

- **C2 URI:** `/fakeurl.htm` (POST method)
- **C2 Beaconing Pattern:** ~60-second intervals, first beacon 2024-11-26T08:50:45 UTC
- **Command Format:** Key-value pairs (CMD=POLL, INFO=1, ACK=1)
- **Network Signature:** Bare-IP POST requests to 194.180.191.64 (no DNS hostname in HTTP Host header)

## Delivery Chain

1. **Lure Domain:** modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP-tagged, labeled as modified/cracked APK distribution)
2. **Delivery Server:** 193.42.38.139 (resolves modandcrackedapk.com)
3. **Payload Transfer:** Encrypted TLS connection; 357 KB received from server (encrypted, hash unrecoverable from PCAP)
4. **Execution:** NetSupport RAT installed and executed; C2 communication initiated at 08:50:45 UTC on 2024-11-26
5. **Persistence:** Regular 60-second beacons to 194.180.191.64:443/fakeurl.htm

## Additional Observations

- The victim is domain-joined to NEMOTODES.health
- The infection occurred after the victim connected to modandcrackedapk.com, consistent with a watering-hole or fake-APK site delivery vector
- SMB traffic shows normal domain policy operations and no obvious lateral movement during the capture window
- No additional local systems appear compromised based on observed traffic
